tool.name: selscan
tool.description: EHH-based scans for positive selection (iHS, nSL, XP-EHH, XP-nSL, iHH12)
tool.command: #set $stat = str($statistic.statistic_selector) selscan --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} --${stat} --${input_format} '$input_file' #if $stat in ('xpehh', 'xpnsl'): #if $input_format == 'hap': --ref '$statistic.ref_input_file' #else: --${input_format}-ref '$statistic.ref_input_file' #end if #end if #if $map_file: --map '$map_file' #end if --maf $maf --cutoff $cutoff --max-gap $max_gap --gap-scale $gap_scale --max-extend $max_extend --max-extend-nsl $max_extend_nsl $pmap $alt $wagh $trunc_ok $keep_low_freq $unphased #if $stat == 'ihs': $statistic.ihs_detail #end if $filter_vcf #if $multi_chr: --multi-chr '$multi_chr' #end if --out outfile #if $alt: && mv outfile.${stat}.alt.out '$scores' #else: && mv outfile.${stat}.out '$scores' #end if && mv outfile.${stat}.log '$log'

param.name: statistic_selector
param.label: Statistic to calculate
param.option: nSL - number of segregating sites by length (single population)
iHH12 - integrated haplotype homozygosity on derived alleles (single population)

param.label: Write detailed iHH scores
param.help: Additionally write the left and right iHH scores for the '1' and '0' alleles.

param.name: ref_input_file
param.label: Reference population file
param.help: Genotype data for the reference population. Must use the same format and contain the same loci as the query population.

param.name: ref_input_file
param.label: Reference population file
param.help: Genotype data for the reference population. Must use the same format and contain the same loci as the query population.

param.name: input_file
param.label: Genotype data
param.help: Phased genotype data coded 0/1. Use the unphased option for multilocus genotypes.

param.label: Minor allele frequency cutoff
param.help: Sites with a MAF below this value are not used as core SNPs.

param.label: EHH decay cutoff
param.help: EHH decay cutoff used to truncate the integration of the decay curve.

param.label: Maximum gap between SNPs (bp)
param.help: Maximum allowed gap in bp between two SNPs.

param.label: Gap scale (bp)
param.help: If a gap between two SNPs is larger than this value but smaller than the maximum gap, the genetic distance is scaled by gap-scale/gap.

param.label: Maximum EHH extension (bp)
param.help: Maximum distance an EHH decay curve is allowed to extend from the core. Set to 0 or less for no restriction.

param.label: Maximum nSL extension (number of SNPs)
param.help: Maximum distance an nSL haplotype is allowed to extend from the core. Set to 0 or less for no restriction.

param.label: Use a physical map
param.help: Use physical positions instead of a genetic map. For VCF input this removes the need for a map file.

param.label: Use squared haplotype frequencies
param.help: Calculate homozygosity from the sum of squared haplotype frequencies in the observed data instead of using binomial coefficients.

param.label: Use the Wagh et al. XP-EHH definition
param.help: Calculate XP-EHH using the definition of EHH that separates core SNP alleles in the denominator. Not compatible with unphased data.

param.label: Accept truncated EHH curves
param.help: If an EHH decay reaches the end of a sequence before reaching the cutoff, integrate the curve anyway instead of discarding the score for that core.

param.label: Keep low frequency variants
param.help: Include low frequency variants in the construction of the haplotypes. By default they are removed.

param.label: Use unphased multilocus genotypes
param.help: Use multilocus genotypes instead of phased haplotypes. Not compatible with iHH12 or the Wagh XP-EHH definition.

param.label: Filter VCF to biallelic SNPs
param.help: Keep only biallelic SNPs with canonical alleles (A, C, G, T); excludes indels, MNPs and ambiguous bases.

param.label: Chromosomes to include
param.help: Comma-separated list of chromosomes to include in the analysis. Leave empty to use all chromosomes.

validator.message: A comma-separated list of chromosome names is required

tool.help:
**What it does**
selscan calculates EHH-based statistics for detecting positive selection from genotype data. This wrapper exposes the single-population statistics **iHS**, **nSL** and **iHH12**, and the cross-population statistics **XP-EHH** and **XP-nSL**.
Data must be phased and coded 0/1 (use the *unphased* option for multilocus genotypes). selscan is agnostic to ancestral/derived coding, so the unstandardized iHS/nSL values are log10(iHH1/iHH0) for the coding you supply. Run the tool separately for each chromosome and, for the cross-population statistics, for each population pair.
-----
**Inputs**
- Genotype data in VCF, HAP, TPED or THAP format. - A map file (chromosome, locus ID, genetic position, physical position) is required for HAP/TPED/THAP input and for VCF input unless the statistic is nSL or XP-nSL, or a physical map is requested. - XP-EHH and XP-nSL additionally require a reference population file with the same loci as the query population.
-----
**Outputs**
- A per-statistic score table (`*.ihs.out`, `*.xpehh.out`, ...) with a header row and a leading chromosome column. - A log file recording the parameters and progress of the run.
Use the companion **selscan norm** tool to normalize scores across frequency bins, compute extreme-score windows and annotate genes.
-----
**Notes**
- `--ihs-detail` adds left/right iHH columns and is only available for iHS. - `--wagh` and `--unphased` are mutually exclusive, and `--unphased` cannot be combined with iHH12. - The number of threads is taken from the Galaxy job configuration (`GALAXY_SLOTS`); it is not exposed as a tool parameter.
